info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Management API
info.description: The Business Unit Management API allows businesses to modify the configurations and details of their operational units within the banking control system. This API provides functionalities to update specific business unit attributes, facilitating efficient organizational management and operational alignment. Typical consumers include financial institutions and internal development teams that require agile modification capabilities for their business units. By allowing targeted updates, this API enhances flexibility and responsiveness to changing business needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific business unit identified by its resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to ensure accurate updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific details of a business unit with the identifier RES-100045. Ensure that all mandatory fields and updated information meet the required schema specifications.
